purpose: Complete the two named proof requirements that the earlier passed receipt does not independently establish; it does not invalidate its completed test and build results.
requirements: Inspect the prior evidence bundle's probes/StartupWaitProbe.java: it pre-initializes EnvUtils and invokes the helper before calling NodeConfig.loadNodeConfig. In fresh JVMs, arrange -DwaitForZk=1 and SOLR_WAIT_FOR_ZK=1 before application start in separate runs, provide zkHost directly in node properties, and call the real NodeConfig.loadNodeConfig without pre-initializing EnvUtils or invoking the timeout helper. Record class initialization ordering and observe that each legacy setting reaches the actual startup client with the expected wait. Include a clean modern-property precedence case where practical. A probe that itself calls EnvUtils or the helper before startup does not establish this leg.

Independently verify both the connection and session timeout delivered to the actual temporary ZooKeeper client for the absent-startup-property 30001 ms fallback and an explicit seconds override. The previous probe asserted the helper value and timed a black-hole connection; that alone does not independently observe the configured session timeout. One possible non-mutating approach is to inspect the outgoing ZooKeeper ConnectRequest session-timeout field at a local accepting peer while separately measuring connection wait; another is equivalent instrumentation that observes the real production builder/client fields. Record method and exact observed values for both timeouts. If the protocol or host prevents a direct observation, report the leg incomplete with the precise limitation rather than inferring it from elapsed time.

Keep the previous receipt's successful exact-head tests, tidy, fail-before and root-check results distinct; no need to rerun those legs unless investigation or a source change invalidates them. Do not describe this follow-up as passing if any required probe is unrun or ambiguous.
Publish a structured receipt and evidence with exact source head, runnable probes, outputs, limitations and executor-stop evidence; do not modify the source branch or post a public comment.
